Trigger.Name: PRE-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 sWhere varchar2(5000);

begin
 sWhere := 'chapter_id = :global.chapter_id' ;

 if :control_block.s_from_date is not null then
 sWhere := sWhere || ' and coll_date >= :control_block.s_from_date' ;
 end if ;

 if :control_block.s_to_date is not null then
 sWhere := sWhere || ' and coll_date <= :control_block.s_to_date' ;
 end if ;

 if :control_block.s_ship_id is not null 
 or :control_block.s_date_needed_by is not null 
 then
 sWhere := sWhere || ' and pat_id || surg_id in ( select distinct pat_id || surg_id 
 from transf_details 
 where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and ship_id = nvl(:control_block.s_ship_id, ship_id)
 and date_needed_by = nvl(:control_block.s_date_needed_by, date_needed_by))' ;

 end if;

 if :control_block.s_pat_id is not null then
 sWhere := sWhere || ' and pat_id = :control_block.s_pat_id ';
 end if ;

-- For Shipped Units 
 if :control_block.s_ship_status = 'S' then 
 sWhere := sWhere || ' and exists ( select distinct unit_id from shipped_products 
 where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and unit_id = special_units.unit_id )' ;
-- For Un-Shipped Units
 elsif :control_block.s_ship_status = 'N' then
 sWhere := sWhere || ' and not exists ( select distinct unit_id from shipped_products 
 where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and unit_id = special_units.unit_id )' ;
 else
 null ;
 end if ;

 if :control_block.s_unit_id is not null then --diptiia for trimming check digit - TR#1029
 sWhere := sWhere || ' and unit_id = decode(length(:control_block.s_unit_id), 15, 
 substr(:control_block.s_unit_id, 1,13),
 :control_block.s_unit_id)' ;
 end if ;

 if :control_block.s_surg_id is not null then
 sWhere := sWhere || ' and surg_id = :control_block.s_surg_id' ;
 end if ;
 set_block_property( 'special_units', default_where, sWhere);
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* Modified and verified for Y2k...Sobha...07/99 */

DECLARE
 cursor ship_id_desc_cur is select distinct td.ship_id ship_id, initcap(cn.short_name) ship_desc,
 substr(to_char(td.surg_date,'MM-DD-YYYY'),1,10) surg_date,
 to_char(td.surg_date,'DY') surg_day,
 td.date_needed_by
 from transf_details td, consignee cn
 where td.ship_id = cn.consignee_id
 and td.pat_id = :special_units.pat_id 
 and td.surg_id = :special_units.surg_id ;

 cursor pat_name_cur is select initcap(pat_last_name || decode(pat_first_name, null, null, ', ')
 || pat_first_name) patient_name 
 from special_patients 
 where pat_id = :special_units.pat_id ;

/* cursor ship_dt_cur is select max(shipped_date) ship_date
 from shipped_products
 where unit_id = :special_units.unit_id ;
*/
 cursor don_type_cur is select donation_type 
 from donations
 where unit_id = :special_units.unit_id ;
 szChkDgt varchar2(3); 

BEGIN

 if length(:special_units.unit_id)=13 then 
 VALIDATE_UNIT_CHKDIGIT(:special_units.unit_id,szChkDgt);
 :special_units.dummy_unit_id:=:special_units.unit_id||ltrim(szChkDgt);
 else
 :special_units.dummy_unit_id:=:special_units.unit_id;
 end if;

 for ship_rec in ship_id_desc_cur loop
 :special_units.ship_id := ship_rec.ship_id ;
 :special_units.ship_desc := ship_rec.ship_desc ;
 :special_units.surg_date := ship_rec.surg_date;
 :special_units.s_day := ship_rec.surg_day;
 :special_units.date_needed_by := ship_rec.date_needed_by;

 end loop ;

 for pat_name_rec in pat_name_cur loop
 :special_units.patient_name := pat_name_rec.patient_name ;
 end loop ;

 for don_type_rec in don_type_cur loop
 :special_units.donation_type := don_type_rec.donation_type ;
 end loop ;

 :special_units.seq := :system.trigger_record ;
end ;

Trigger.Name: ON-POPULATE-DETAILS
Trigger.TriggerText:
--
-- Begin default relation declare section
--
DECLARE
 recstat VARCHAR2(20) := :System.record_status; 
 startitm VARCHAR2(61) := :System.cursor_item; 
 rel_id Relation;
--
-- End default relation declare section
--
--
-- Begin default relation program section
--
BEGIN
 IF ( recstat = 'NEW' or recstat = 'INSERT' ) THEN 
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 --
 -- Begin SHIPPED_PRODUCTS detail program section
 --
 IF ( (:SPECIAL_UNITS.UNIT_ID is not null) ) THEN 
 rel_id := Find_Relation('SPECIAL_UNITS.SPECIAL_UNITS_SHIPPED_PRODUCTS'); 
 Query_Master_Details(rel_id, 'SHIPPED_PRODUCTS'); 
 END IF;
 --
 -- End SHIPPED_PRODUCTS detail program section
 --
 --
 -- Begin DIRDES_DONORS detail program section
 --
 IF ( (:SPECIAL_UNITS.PAT_ID is not null) or (:SPECIAL_UNITS.SEQ_NO is not null) ) THEN 
 rel_id := Find_Relation('SPECIAL_UNITS.SPECIAL_UNITS_DIRDES_DONORS'); 
 Query_Master_Details(rel_id, 'DIRDES_DONORS'); 
 END IF;
 --
 -- End DIRDES_DONORS detail program section
 --

 IF ( :System.cursor_item <> startitm ) THEN 
 Go_Item(startitm); 
 Check_Package_Failure; 
 END IF;
END;
--
-- End default relation program section
--

Trigger.Name: ON-CHECK-DELETE-MASTER
Trigger.TriggerText:
--
-- Begin default relation declare section
--
DECLARE
 Dummy_Define CHAR(1);
 --
 -- Begin SHIPPED_PRODUCTS detail declare section
 --
 CURSOR SHIPPED_PRODUCTS_cur IS 
 SELECT 1 FROM SHIPPED_PRODUCTS 
 WHERE UNIT_ID = :SPECIAL_UNITS.UNIT_ID;
 --
 -- End SHIPPED_PRODUCTS detail declare section
 --
 --
 -- Begin DIRDES_DONORS detail declare section
 --
 CURSOR DIRDES_DONORS_cur IS 
 SELECT 1 FROM dirdes_donors 
 WHERE PAT_ID = :SPECIAL_UNITS.PAT_ID and SEQ_NO = :SPECIAL_UNITS.SEQ_NO;
 --
 -- End DIRDES_DONORS detail declare section
 --
--
-- End default relation declare section
--
--
-- Begin default relation program section
--
BEGIN
 --
 -- Begin SHIPPED_PRODUCTS detail program section
 --
 OPEN SHIPPED_PRODUCTS_cur; 
 FETCH SHIPPED_PRODUCTS_cur INTO Dummy_Define; 
 IF ( SHIPPED_PRODUCTS_cur%found ) THEN 
 Message('Cannot delete master record when matching detail records exist.'); 
 CLOSE SHIPPED_PRODUCTS_cur; 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;
 CLOSE SHIPPED_PRODUCTS_cur;
 --
 -- End SHIPPED_PRODUCTS detail program section
 --
 --
 -- Begin DIRDES_DONORS detail program section
 --
 OPEN DIRDES_DONORS_cur;

 IF ( DIRDES_DONORS_cur%found ) THEN 
 Message('Cannot delete master record when matching detail records exist.'); 
 CLOSE DIRDES_DONORS_cur; 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;
 CLOSE DIRDES_DONORS_cur;
 --
 -- End DIRDES_DONORS detail program section
 --
END;

-- End default relation program section

ProgramUnit.Name: TIME_FORMAT_FUNCTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE time_format_function( input_str in varchar2,
 output_str out varchar2) IS
 string_length number ;
 formatted_str varchar2(5) ;
BEGIN
/*-- This procedure formats time in HH24:MI format ---*/ 

 string_length := NVL( length( input_str), 0) ;

 if string_length > 5 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 elsif string_length = 5 then
 if substr( input_str, 3, 1) = ':' then
 if to_number( substr( input_str, 1, 2)) > 23 
 or to_number( substr( input_str, 4, 2)) > 59 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 else
 output_str := input_str ;
 end if ;
 else
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 elsif string_length = 4 then
 if to_number( substr( input_str, 1, 2)) > 23 
 or to_number( substr( input_str, 3, 2)) > 59 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 output_str := substr( input_str, 1, 2) || ':' || 
 substr( input_str, 3, 2) ;
 else
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
exception
 when value_error then 
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 when others then
 handle_error ;
 check_package_failure ;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_MASTER_DETAILS

PROCEDURE Query_Master_Details(rel_id Relation,detail VARCHAR2) IS
 oldmsg VARCHAR2(2); -- Old Message Level Setting
 reldef VARCHAR2(5); -- Relation Deferred Setting
BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Variable(s)
 --
 reldef := Get_Relation_Property(rel_id, DEFERRED_COORDINATION);
 oldmsg := :System.Message_Level;
 --
 -- If NOT Deferred, Goto detail and execute the query.
 --
 IF reldef = 'FALSE' THEN
 Go_Block(detail);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 :System.Message_Level := '10';
 Execute_Query;
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Relation is deferred, mark the detail block as un-coordinated
 --
 Set_Block_Property(detail, COORDINATION_STATUS, NON_COORDINATED);
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 RAISE;
END Query_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Trigger_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;
